status_values.implemented: Exported and covered by compatibility tests
status_values.partial: Only the explicitly described mode is implemented
status_values.pending: Not declared as working and not silently approximated

functions.name: srt_accept
functions.scope: blocking and nonblocking IPv4/IPv6 HSv5 caller/listener with scope-aware names, a completed-connection backlog, encrypted connections, listener-callback admission, and first-member Broadcast/Backup mirror-group results; rendezvous uses connect on both peers

functions.name: srt_accept_bond
functions.scope: validated blocking IPv4/IPv6 multi-listener accept with deterministic first-ready selection, finite/infinite timeout, close wakeup, documented error behavior, and explicit listener-bond domains that admit one mirror group across distinct listeners; pinned Broadcast/Backup interoperability runs in both implementation directions

functions.name: srt_addlogfa
functions.scope: thread-safe enablement of one bounded functional-area value without protocol-core coupling

functions.name: srt_bind
functions.scope: direct IPv4/IPv6 bind, port autoselection, scope IDs, SRTO_IPV6ONLY, dual-stack overlap handling, state and error behavior, compatible same-address shared UDP multiplexers, shared listener/accepted-socket ownership, and SRT_EBINDCONFLICT diagnostics; group members use per-endpoint source binding rather than binding the masked group handle

functions.name: srt_bind_acquire
functions.scope: takes ownership of an already-bound, unconnected IPv4 or IPv6 UDP socket on success, preserves caller ownership on validation or setup failure, queries native IPV6_V6ONLY where applicable, configures it nonblocking, and integrates it with channel dispatch and lifecycle cleanup

functions.name: srt_bind_peerof
functions.scope: deprecated public-header inline alias of srt_bind_acquire

functions.name: srt_bistats
functions.scope: connected-socket totals, resettable interval counters, IPv4/IPv6 wire-byte rates, negotiated MSS, instantaneous or moving-average runtime buffer state, RTT, pacing, bandwidth, physical receive loss, adaptive reorder distance/tolerance, belated packets, retransmission, ACK/NAK, undecryptable, received filter-extra, FEC sender-extra/supply/loss metrics, and distinct internal TTL/TLPKTDROP accounting; focused IPv6 MSS/wire-byte, bidirectional FileCC loss/retransmission, and rendezvous reorder/belated validation passes while drop, undecryptable, and FEC filter external validation remains

functions.name: srt_bstats
functions.scope: connected-socket totals, resettable interval counters, IPv4/IPv6 wire-byte rates, negotiated MSS, moving-average runtime buffer state, RTT, pacing, bandwidth, physical receive loss, adaptive reorder distance/tolerance, belated packets, retransmission, ACK/NAK, undecryptable, received filter-extra, FEC sender-extra/supply/loss metrics, and combined public sender-drop accounting; focused IPv6 MSS/wire-byte, bidirectional FileCC loss/retransmission, and rendezvous reorder/belated validation passes while drop, undecryptable, and FEC filter external validation remains

functions.name: srt_close
functions.scope: idempotent socket and masked-group close with tombstones; sockets add connected-peer shutdown control, blocked-call wakeup, synchronous SRTO_LINGER drain, and centrally managed deferred asynchronous linger

functions.name: srt_config_add
functions.scope: thread-safe bounded copy storage for the complete v1.5.7 per-member option allowlist; application to newly connected group members follows with srt_connect_group

functions.name: srt_connect
functions.scope: blocking and nonblocking IPv4/IPv6 caller or bound same-family rendezvous peer with retries, timeout, HSv5 negotiation, encrypted key exchange, dual-stack IPv4-mapped destinations, and state/error transitions; a masked Broadcast/Backup group handle creates a caller-side member through the shared group connect path, and compatible listener-side mirror admission is implemented

functions.name: srt_connect_bind
functions.scope: IPv4/IPv6 socket bind-then-connect with both addresses validated before mutation, exact source-address acquisition, same-family enforcement, and one-member Broadcast/Backup group creation through the shared endpoint path

functions.name: srt_connect_callback
functions.scope: individual nonblocking IPv4/IPv6 caller and rendezvous sockets plus replaceable Broadcast/Backup group registration; the current group hook is snapshotted into each new member, and exactly-once background success, timeout, and close-cancellation delivery preserves the original target address, member socket ID, and endpoint token (-1 for individual sockets), with no socket/group lock held, exception containment, deterministic coverage, and pinned v1.5.7 interoperability validation

functions.name: srt_connect_debug
functions.scope: regular socket/group connect semantics plus a socket-only forced 31-bit initial sequence; -1 selects the normal generated value, invalid negative values are rejected, and groups retain their managed shared ISN

functions.name: srt_connect_group
functions.scope: creates endpoint-configured nonblocking caller members, applies source binding and bounded per-member overrides, preserves or generates tokens, synchronizes the group ISN, supports repeated late-member additions at the current ordering point, records generation-checked results, and validates one compatible peer mirror identity; bidirectional listener admission plus Broadcast and Backup payload I/O are implemented, while mixed-reference encrypted replay/failover and broader simultaneous path faults remain pending

functions.name: srt_connection_time
functions.scope: returns the socket-open instant in the same steady-clock microsecond epoch as srt_time_now and message source times; the value is stable for the socket lifetime, while invalid, group, and closed handles return -1 with SRT_EINVSOCK; pinned v1.5.7 completion probes validate the shared epoch in both implementation directions

functions.name: srt_create_config
functions.scope: allocates an opaque thread-safe, bounded per-member option object

functions.name: srt_create_group
functions.scope: creates caller and listener-mirror Broadcast/Backup handles in a separate masked, generation-ready registry with cleanup-safe lifecycle and synchronized send/receive ordering; Broadcast fan-out/deduplication and Backup weighted active-path failover/replay are implemented, while balancing and future policies require separate negotiation

functions.name: srt_delete_config
functions.scope: releases an opaque configuration object and accepts null

functions.name: srt_dellogfa
functions.scope: thread-safe disablement of one bounded functional-area value without protocol-core coupling

functions.name: srt_epoll_uwait
functions.scope: SRT sockets and groups, level/edge triggering, timeout, bounded output, empty/output flags, connect/accept/message/error readiness, and edge-only listener/group UPDATE events; unrestricted process-level reference tests pending

functions.name: srt_epoll_wait
functions.scope: SRT sockets, groups, and system sockets, level/edge triggering, timeout and error-array behavior; UPDATE is intentionally neither reported nor consumed, matching the documented uwait-only contract; unrestricted process-level reference tests pending

functions.name: srt_getpeername
functions.scope: connected IPv4/IPv6 caller and accepted sockets, including IPv4-mapped IPv6 dual-stack peers

functions.name: srt_getsndbuffer
functions.scope: current packet blocks, payload bytes, and buffered timestamp span in milliseconds, with independently optional output pointers

functions.name: srt_getsockflag

functions.name: srt_getsockname
functions.scope: IPv4/IPv6 bound, caller, listener, and accepted sockets with IPv6 scope IDs

functions.name: srt_getsockopt
functions.scope: options marked implemented below

functions.name: srt_getsockstate
functions.scope: individual sockets plus masked connection-group handles; empty open groups follow the v1.5.7 SRTS_BROKEN result

functions.name: srt_group_data
functions.scope: capacity-checked v1.5.7 size queries and immutable generation-tagged caller/listener member state, result, weight, endpoint, and token snapshots, including Broadcast results plus Backup RUNNING/IDLE/BROKEN transitions; broader reference-version policy probes remain pending

functions.name: srt_groupof
functions.scope: generation-checks non-owning caller/listener member identity and rejects stale or closed memberships

functions.name: srt_listen
functions.scope: bound IPv4/IPv6 sockets, bounded pending-handshake queue, background handshake processing, completed-connection backlog, final-response replay for duplicate conclusions, callback admission after HSREQ parsing, and SRTO_GROUPCONNECT Broadcast/Backup mirror admission

functions.name: srt_listen_callback
functions.scope: pre-listen registration and removal, one worker-thread invocation per incoming HSv5 conclusion with connecting socket, peer address, NUL-terminated Stream ID, callback-scoped pre-connection option and passphrase mutation, exception-safe rejection, application-defined rejection reason transmission, and rejected-socket exclusion from accept; pinned v1.5.7 encrypted-accept and clear-reject validation in both listener directions

functions.name: srt_prepare_endpoint
functions.scope: initializes compatible IPv4/IPv6 group endpoint records while rejecting null, truncated, unknown-family, and mixed-family inputs without the reference implementation's unchecked memcpy behavior

functions.name: srt_recv
functions.scope: IPv4/IPv6 live/message and stream/file modes with blocking, nonblocking, timeout, TSBPD where applicable, reliability, non-consuming short-message rejection, partial buffer reads, buffered drain after SRTS_BROKEN, post-drain stream EOF, encryption, and epoll readiness; a bidirectional pinned individual-socket gate requires empty-receive errors, post-broken drain, exact payload integrity, and mode-specific terminal results; Broadcast receive selects one ordered copy and suppresses redundant member prefixes, while Backup receives from the current running path, and both retain a published-broken member until its final TSBPD-buffered message is drained

functions.name: srt_recvfile
functions.scope: blocking stream/file transfer with validated path, offset, size and block arguments, exact offset advancement, EOF, documented file/mode errors, PEERERROR signaling on write failure, and bidirectional pinned v1.5.7 clear plus AES-128/192/256 rotating transfer using asymmetric block sizes and fail-closed wrong-passphrase rejection

functions.name: srt_recvmsg
functions.scope: alias of the implemented live/message or stream/file extraction selected by SRTO_MESSAGEAPI, including non-consuming short-message rejection, buffered drain after SRTS_BROKEN, and Broadcast/Backup terminal-member drain

functions.name: srt_recvmsg2
functions.scope: live/message and stream/file modes with srctime, pktseq, and msgno output where applicable, including non-consuming short-message rejection and buffered drain before the terminal Message error or Stream EOF; Broadcast group receive adds bounded selected-member metadata, duplicate suppression, and terminal-member TSBPD drain, while Backup reports the selected running or final drained member

functions.name: srt_rendezvous
functions.scope: same-family IPv4/IPv6 bind-and-connect convenience API; masked group handles are explicitly unsupported because Haivision v1.5.7 defines compatible groups only for caller/listener Live mode

functions.name: srt_resetlogfa
functions.scope: atomic replacement of the fixed 64-area selection with null safety, invalid-area rejection, and a bounded input scan

functions.name: srt_send
functions.scope: IPv4/IPv6 live/message and stream/file modes with LiveCC/FileCC pacing, retransmission, partial buffer writes, blocking, nonblocking, timeout, and encryption; Broadcast group send fans out one common packet/message identity, while Backup uses weighted single-path selection, qualification, failover, and bounded replay

functions.name: srt_sendfile
functions.scope: blocking stream/file transfer with exact offset advancement, size=-1 to EOF, bounded block buffering, documented file/mode errors, SRT_EPEERERR wakeup, and bidirectional pinned v1.5.7 clear plus AES-128/192/256 rotating transfer using asymmetric block sizes and fail-closed wrong-passphrase rejection

functions.name: srt_sendmsg
functions.scope: live/message and stream/file modes, including Broadcast group fan-out; finite per-message TTL is implemented for the message API with rollover-safe DROPREQ and repeated-NAK recovery

functions.name: srt_sendmsg2
functions.scope: live/message and stream/file modes with inorder, srctime, msgno, and finite per-message TTL where applicable; Broadcast group send adds common source time, packet/message identity, at-least-one-path success, failed-path isolation, and bounded member results; Backup preserves the same metadata through weighted path selection and replay

functions.name: srt_setlogflags
functions.scope: all four v1.5.7 prefix/EOL formatting flags, applied atomically to later compatibility-layer events

functions.name: srt_setloghandler
functions.scope: coherent concurrent handler/opaque replacement, serialized callback lifetime, recursive-log suppression, callback-side configuration, and C++ exception containment

functions.name: srt_setloglevel
functions.scope: syslog-compatible integer severity threshold with immediate application to later compatibility-layer events

socket_options.name: SRTO_MSS
socket_options.scope: advertised in the HSv5 handshake; both peers adopt the lower value, IPv4 and IPv6 payload limits subtract their respective wire headers, SRT ring byte options realign to MSS minus UDP/IP overhead, and native UDP buffers remain at least MSS; jumbo MSS values above the current 1500-byte datagram ceiling are rejected

socket_options.name: SRTO_SNDSYN
socket_options.scope: individual sockets and Broadcast/Backup group handles

socket_options.name: SRTO_RCVSYN
socket_options.scope: individual sockets and Broadcast/Backup group handles; pinned bidirectional individual and group matrices require immediate SRT_EASYNCRCV on an empty connected entity when disabled

socket_options.name: SRTO_ISN
socket_options.scope: 31-bit local initial data sequence number; classic accepted sockets expose the negotiated caller ISN and rendezvous sockets retain their local directional ISN

socket_options.name: SRTO_SNDBUF
socket_options.scope: byte values align down to current-MSS-minus-28-byte UDP/IP packet slots after enforcing the 32-slot minimum and allocate the compatibility send buffer

socket_options.name: SRTO_RCVBUF
socket_options.scope: byte values align down to current-MSS-minus-28-byte UDP/IP packet slots after enforcing the 32-slot minimum, are capped by SRTO_FC, and allocate the compatibility receive buffer

socket_options.name: SRTO_LINGER
socket_options.scope: get/set validation, transmission-type defaults, synchronous send-buffer drain, and centrally managed deferred close when SRTO_SNDSYN is false

socket_options.name: SRTO_UDP_SNDBUF
socket_options.scope: positive values are clamped to MSS and applied as native SO_SNDBUF before explicit or implicit binding; accepted sockets inherit the effective value

socket_options.name: SRTO_UDP_RCVBUF
socket_options.scope: positive values are clamped to MSS and applied as native SO_RCVBUF before explicit or implicit binding; accepted sockets inherit the effective value

socket_options.name: SRTO_SNDTIMEO
socket_options.scope: individual sockets and Broadcast/Backup group handles

socket_options.name: SRTO_RCVTIMEO
socket_options.scope: individual sockets and Broadcast/Backup group handles; pinned individual sockets require bounded SRT_ETIMEOUT for a 150 ms empty receive; Robotweax groups return the same result, while a retained legacy-v1.5.5 lane classifies that reference version's SRT_EASYNCRCV result separately

socket_options.name: SRTO_REUSEADDR
socket_options.scope: compatible exact IPv4 or IPv6 bindings share one UDP channel; disabled reuse, overlapping wildcard/dual-stack coverage, differing IPV6_V6ONLY modes, or mismatched UDP buffer settings report SRT_EBINDCONFLICT

socket_options.name: SRTO_EVENT
socket_options.scope: individual sockets only; uses the exact readiness snapshot shared with epoll across init, listen, connect, connected, TSBPD-delayed, broken, and closing states

socket_options.name: SRTO_SNDDATA
socket_options.scope: individual sockets only; current unacknowledged send-ring occupancy for Live and File modes

socket_options.name: SRTO_RCVDATA
socket_options.scope: individual sockets only; current occupied receive-ring packets, including complete data waiting for its TSBPD deadline

socket_options.name: SRTO_SENDER
socket_options.scope: pre-connection sender-role hint with compatible get/set behavior and state validation; used by the public interoperability peer for role-sensitive packet-filter negotiation

socket_options.name: SRTO_IPTTL
socket_options.scope: portable IPv4 IP_TTL or IPv6 IPV6_UNICAST_HOPS application before explicit, implicit, or acquired binding; bound getters inspect the native socket; accepted sockets and group-created members inherit the effective value; pinned IPv6 caller/listener probes cover both implementation directions

socket_options.name: SRTO_IPTOS
socket_options.scope: native IPv4 IP_TOS and supported Unix IPv6 IPV6_TCLASS application before explicit, implicit, or acquired binding; bound getters inspect the native socket; accepted sockets and group-created members inherit the effective value; pinned Linux IPv6 caller/listener probes cover both implementation directions; Winsock lacks a settable IPV6_TCLASS, so the unmodified default does not block IPv6 operation while an explicit Windows IPv6 request fails with SRT_EINVOP pending a QoS-flow backend

socket_options.name: SRTO_PEERVERSION
socket_options.scope: connected sockets expose the peer SRT software version decoded from HSv5 extensions; unconnected and provisional listener-callback sockets plus rejected legacy/non-SRT peers return zero; accepted sockets retain the negotiated observation after connection completion; group handles derive the first member value and return zero while empty; pinned Haivision v1.5.7 caller/listener and Broadcast/Backup probes require 0x00010507 after connection

socket_options.name: SRTO_DRIFTTRACER
socket_options.scope: dynamically gates receiver TSBPD drift sampling from forward unique DATA and KEEPALIVE timestamps without resetting the established time base; caller groups and listener mirrors derive and propagate the value; pinned v1.5.7 probes validate the default

socket_options.name: SRTO_MININPUTBW
socket_options.scope: fixed-memory application-input estimation uses this floor only in relative LiveCC mode when both SRTO_MAXBW and SRTO_INPUTBW are zero; explicit input or absolute/unlimited maximum bandwidth retains precedence; groups derive and dynamically propagate the value; pinned v1.5.7 probes validate the default

socket_options.name: SRTO_MINVERSION
socket_options.scope: rejects an explicitly advertised lower SRT software version with SRT_REJ_VERSION in caller/listener and both rendezvous roles without treating an omitted optional response extension as version zero; caller groups and listener mirrors derive the value; pinned v1.5.7 probes validate the 1.0.0 default

socket_options.name: SRTO_STREAMID
socket_options.scope: bounded exact-byte get/set; HSv5 type-5 Caller-to-Listener exchange; accepted-socket observation without listener inheritance; protocol-initiator behavior retained but documented as unsuitable for Rendezvous; pinned Haivision v1.5.7 bidirectional validation shares the IPv6 MSS/statistics gate

socket_options.name: SRTO_CONGESTION
socket_options.scope: independent LiveCC/FileCC selection, HSv5 type-6 CONFIG proposal with optional response echo, default-live request omission, mismatch rejection, accepted-socket inheritance, and runtime controller activation; pinned Haivision caller/listener and rendezvous validation passes in both directions, including NAK, sender-RTO, burst-loss, dynamic-MAXBW, shutdown/EOF, both Robotweax cookie roles, and focused IPv6 recovery; sustained-loss and large-BDP validation remain pending

socket_options.name: SRTO_TRANSTYPE
socket_options.scope: SRTT_LIVE and protocol-relevant SRTT_FILE defaults, including complete local linger behavior; pinned Haivision caller/listener loss/RTO, loss-free rendezvous, and bidirectional AES-128/192/256 rotating Stream validation pass, with AES-256 matching-NAK and flight-tail sender-RTO recovery

socket_options.name: SRTO_IPV6ONLY
socket_options.scope: native IPV6_V6ONLY control; explicit IPv6 wildcard bind requires 0 or 1, implicit bind uses and records the system default, and acquired IPv6 sockets expose their actual mode

socket_options.name: SRTO_BINDTODEVICE
socket_options.scope: socket-only Linux SO_BINDTODEVICE control with native post-bind inspection and acquired/shared-channel compatibility; non-Linux platforms and group handles deterministically return SRT_EINVOP; native bind failures retain the operating-system error

socket_options.name: SRTO_GROUPCONNECT
socket_options.scope: listener option with callback-scoped mutation, transactional Broadcast/Backup mirror admission, first-member accept, and silent later-member attachment

socket_options.name: SRTO_GROUPMINSTABLETIMEO
socket_options.scope: Backup-group-only coordinator option; RTT/variation-adaptive response timeout bounded by peer latency and peer-idle timeout; deterministic silent-path failover and fresh-activation anti-oscillation coverage

socket_options.name: SRTO_GROUPTYPE
socket_options.scope: socket-only incoming group declaration exposed as Broadcast or Backup while srt_listen_callback is executing; deterministic SRT_GTYPE_UNDEFINED outside that callback and for ordinary connections; group-handle get/set and socket set reject with SRT_EINVOP; pinned Haivision v1.5.7 listener probes validate both supported group types

socket_options.name: SRTO_PACKETFILTER
socket_options.scope: bounded fec configuration, payload reservation, HSv5 negotiation, allocation-bounded row, column, and positive multi-row parity, even/staircase placement, iterative recursive reconstruction, AES-CTR wire-payload recovery, ONREQ irrecoverability handoff, safe ARQ fallback, filter statistics, checked pre-allocation resource estimates, no-growth wire-input properties, and dedicated control fuzzing; pinned mixed-implementation caller/listener validation covers every built-in geometry, AES-256 Matrix-FEC rotation, sequence rollover, and clear/encrypted Rendezvous single and geometry-specific burst loss in both sender directions; retained 32x32 Even and 64x32 Staircase long-chain fixtures cover iterative reconstruction; sustained seed/fuzz campaigns with automatic failure-corpus retention, external latency sizing, and real two-node faults remain pending

socket_options.name: SRTO_CRYPTOMODE
socket_options.scope: not part of the default Haivision v1.5.7 build profile; upstream labels the disabled-by-default AEAD surface as a future v1.6.0 API and the selected SRT draft does not define its AES-GCM protocol

socket_options.name: SRTO_MAXREXMITBW
socket_options.scope: not part of the default Haivision v1.5.7 build profile; upstream labels the disabled-by-default retransmission limiter as a future v1.6.0 API

constant_groups.name: socket_and_group_masks
constant_groups.scope: SRT_INVALID_SOCK=-1, platform-correct SYSSOCKET_INVALID, SRTGROUP_MASK, and SRT_ERROR

constant_groups.name: logging_levels_flags_and_functional_areas
constant_groups.scope: syslog-compatible levels, four v1.5.7 formatting flags, and exact public functional-area values through SRT_LOGFA_LASTNONE=63

constant_groups.name: group_and_bonding_constants
constant_groups.scope: SRTGROUP_MASK and SRT_GFLAG_SYNCONMSG plus exact v1.5.7 group/member enum values; the flag is ABI-visible but the pinned compatibility profile rejects it exactly because v1.5.7 does not implement message-number synchronization
